facts.title: high potential incident during cleaning and preparation on P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4104, M-4104 and PT-4104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 May 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4104, M-4104 and PT-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
